message.content:
Below is a **ready‑to‑copy** list of the *long weekends* that Canadians enjoyed during 2023.  
A “long weekend” here means **at least three consecutive non‑working days**, which usually happens when a statutory holiday lands on a Friday, Monday, or close enough to a weekend that most workers simply add the intervening weekday(s) to their break.

> ⚠️ **Provincial Variations** – While the table shows the *federal* holidays that created long weekends everywhere, several provinces added their own holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, Heritage Days, etc.). Those additional dates appear only in the columns marked with the relevant province abbreviation.

| # | Date(s) | Holiday | Province(s) affected | Notes |
|---|---------|--------|----------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Jan 1 (Thu)** → **Jan 2 (Fri)** | New Year’s Day (Observed) | All | Because Jan 1 fell on a Sunday, the paid day was moved to Monday Feb 2, making **Fri Jan 2–Sun Jan 4** a 3‑day stretch. |
| 2 | **Mar 10 (Fri)** → **Mar 13 (Mon)** | Good Friday / Easter Monday | All | Gives **Fri Mar 10–Tue Mar 13** (four days). |
| 3 | **Apr 28 (Mon)** | Victoria Day | All | Creates **Sat Apr 22–Mon Apr 28** (six days). |
| 4 | **Sep 4 (Mon)** | Labour Day | All | Standard **Sat Sep 2–Mon Sep 4** long weekend. |
| 5 | **Oct 9 (Mon)** | Thanksgiving | All | **Sat Oct 7–Mon Oct 9**. |
| 6 | **Dec 23 (Sat)** → **Dec 25 (Mon)** | Christmas | All | **Sat Dec 23–Mon Dec 25** (three days). |

### Provincial Additions (that also produced long weekends)

| Province | Extra Holiday | Dates in 2023 | Resulting Long Weekend |
|----------|---------------|--------------|------------------------|
| BC       | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 16 (Tue) | Tue Mar 16–Wed Mar 17 (short) — *not* a long weekend unless combined with other breaks. |
| AB       | Family Day (Third Monday) | Feb 20 (Mon) | **Sat Feb 18–Mon Feb 20** (three days). |
| ON       | Family Day (First Monday) | Feb 13 (Mon) | **Sat Feb 11–Mon Feb 13** (three days). |
| MB       | Louis Riel Day (Second Monday) | Feb 27 (Mon) | **Sat Feb 25–Mon Feb 27** (three days). |
| NB       | Saint John’s Day (Fourth Monday) | Aug 7 (Mon) | **Sat Aug 5–Mon Aug 7** (three days). |
| PEI      | National Patriots' Day (Third Monday) | Mar 20 (Mon) | **Sat Mar 18–Mon Mar 20** (three days). |
| QC       | Saint‑Joseph’s Day (Last Monday) | Jun 19 (Mon) | **Sat Jun 17–Mon Jun 19** (three days). |
| SK       | Family Day (Third Monday) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Same as AB above. |
| NL       | Memorial Day (last Monday) | Jul 3 (Mon) | **Sat Jul 1–Mon Jul 3** (three days). |
| NS       | Natal Day (first Monday) | June 5 (Mon) | **Sat June 3–Mon June 5** (three days). |
| NT/NWT   | N/A | — | — |
| YT        | N/A | — | — |

*(If your application needs province‑specific calendars, filter the rows accordingly.)*

---

#### Quick Integration Tips

```jsonc
{
  "longWeekends": [
    {"start":"2023-01-02","end":"2023-01-04"},
    {"start":"2023-03-10","end":"2023-03-13"},
    {"start":"2023-04-22","end":"2023-04-28"},
    {"start":"2023-09-02","end":"2023-09-04"},
    {"start":"2023-10-07","end":"2023-10-09"},
    {"start":"2023-12-23","end":"2023-12-25"}
  ],
  "provincialLongs":[
     {"province":"AB","holiday":"Family Day","dates":["2023-02-18","2023-02-20"]},
     ...
  ]
}
```

Feel free to adjust the JSON structure to match your existing schema!
